Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Transient stimulus with delayed re-challenge
ideas.description: Expose cells to a transient AP-1-activating stimulus (e.g., TPA, TNF, or injury), let signaling return to baseline, then re-stimulate days to weeks later. Compare transcriptional output and chromatin accessibility to naive cells to test for primed, enhanced responses.

ideas.title: Longitudinal ATAC-seq/CUT&RUN of AP-1 occupancy and chromatin state
ideas.description: Track AP-1 factor binding (FOS, JUN, FOSL) and accessibility plus H3K27ac/H3K4me1 at AP-1 motif-containing enhancers before, during, and long after stimulation. Persistent accessibility or histone marks after AP-1 binding is lost would indicate AP-1 establishes a lasting epigenetic memory.

ideas.title: Acute degradation of AP-1 during stimulus versus memory phase
ideas.description: Use dTAG/auxin-degron or dominant-negative A-FOS to remove AP-1 either during the initial stimulus or only during the later maintenance period. This separates AP-1's role in writing memory (needed only initially) from maintaining it (needed continuously).

ideas.title: Single-cell live imaging of AP-1 dynamics and heritability
ideas.description: Use fluorescent reporters of AP-1 activity and endogenously tagged FOS/JUN to follow single cells and their lineages through stimulation and division. Quantify whether activity history predicts later responses and whether the state is inherited across cell divisions, indicating bistability or feedback.

ideas.title: Motif mutation and synthetic enhancer tests with in vivo validation
ideas.description: Use CRISPR to edit or delete AP-1 motifs at candidate memory enhancers, or use dCas9-based tethering of AP-1/chromatin modifiers, and measure the effect on memory-associated accessibility and re-stimulation response. Complement with in vivo models such as epidermal wound or inflammation paradigms with lineage tracing to test relevance in tissue.
